rca_of_the_issue: Submit failure RCA: frontend posts to /api/submit-product-inquiry-lead (404, not implemented) and falls back to a direct Supabase insert. The table created by /app/legacy_source/supabase/migrations/20260512150000_product_inquiry_leads.sql defines constraint product_inquiry_leads_product_check CHECK (product IN ('aktien','anleihen','spargeld')). Session 60 introduced fonds/tagesgeld/festgeld/flexgeld in the frontend only, so PostgREST rejects those rows with HTTP 400 / SQLSTATE 23514 and mapProductInquiryInsertError shows a generic error toast. Reproduce: open home -> sticky CTA -> product-inquiry-option-fonds -> answer 6 questions -> fill contact + 2 consents -> Absenden -> network shows 400 23514. Mitigation: widen the CHECK constraint via migration.
